provider_spend.scope: Entire approved M00 window, including the fresh normal-app build, bounded repair, and quality judgments.

synthetic_identity.name: FC01 internal synthetic canary
synthetic_identity.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of campaign identifier plus the prior sanitized campaign fingerprint; raw account identity is never persisted here.

severity_rubric.P0: Security/privacy breach, secret exposure, cross-user data, irreversible corruption, destructive migration, artifact/data loss, false publication/completion, or unavailable rollback.
severity_rubric.P1: Reproducible failure of auth, text, ordinary Builder, artifact retrieval, primary voice, fallback, startup/readiness, or unexpected crash/5xx in the frozen envelope.
severity_rubric.P2: Non-core but material UX, accessibility, control, observability, or fidelity defect inside the frozen envelope.
severity_rubric.P3: Cosmetic or explicitly out-of-scope debt with no effect on the frozen envelope. Only Davide and Luis may accept it with issue, owner, expiry, affected path, and proof.

abort_conditions: Any source, tree, provider deployment, migration head, or signed receipt identity moves or cannot be re-established.
Any readiness or health requirement fails, or a Render deploy exceeds 15 minutes.
Any unexpected 5xx, crash, boot loop, browser exception, auth/session/ownership anomaly, leak, orphan, duplicate terminal, or duplicate publication occurs.
Any artifact is published before required mechanical and quality approval.
Any migration/catalog ambiguity or destructive operation appears.
Observability changes product truth or user-visible completion.
A repair/deployment/cost ceiling is consumed or the maintenance window ends.
Any P0, P1, or mission-scope P2 is observed.
